description: Source code for speed density fuel calculation in engine control software, including functions for temperature correction, air mass calculation, and fuel injection timing.

methods.name: getTCharge
methods.description: Calculates temperature correction based on RPM, TPS, coolant and air temperature.

methods.name: getCycleAirMass
methods.description: Calculates air mass in grams per cycle based on volumetric efficiency, MAP, and temperature.

methods.name: sdMath
methods.description: Calculates injection time in seconds based on air mass and AFR.

methods.name: getSpeedDensityFuel
methods.description: Calculates fuel injection time in milliseconds using speed density method.

methods.name: setDefaultVETable
methods.description: Initializes VE and AFR tables with default values.

methods.name: initSpeedDensity
methods.description: Initializes speed density tables and maps.
